title: Assessing the robustness of heterogeneous treatment effects in survival analysis under informative censoring
abstract: arXiv:2510.13397v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Dropout is common in clinical studies, with up to half of patients leaving early due to side effects or other reasons. When dropout is informative (i.e., dependent on survival time), it introduces censoring bias, because of which treatment effect estimates are also biased. In this paper, we propose an assumption-lean framework to assess the robustness of conditional average treatment effect (CATE) estimates in survival analysis when facing censoring bias. Unlike existing works that rely on strong assumptions, such as non-informative censoring, to obtain point estimation, we use partial identification to derive informative bounds on the CATE. Thereby, our framework helps to identify patient subgroups where treatment is effective despite informative censoring. translated_title: 评估信息性删失下生存分析中异质性处理效应的稳健性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2510.13397v4 公告类型：替换 摘要：脱落（中途退出）在临床研究中很常见，高达一半的患者可能因副作用或其他原因提前退出研究。当脱落具有信息性时（即与生存时间相关），会引入删失偏差，从而导致处理效应估计也出现偏差。在本文中，我们提出了一个少假设框架，用于在面临删失偏差时评估生存分析中条件平均处理效应（CATE）估计的稳健性。与现有依赖强假设（如非信息性删失）来获得点估计的工作不同，我们采用部分识别方法推导出CATE的信息性边界。由此，我们的框架有助于识别出尽管存在信息性删失但治疗仍然有效的患者亚群。我们进一步提出了一种新颖的模型无关元学习器，称为SurvB-learner，用于估计这些边界，该方法可与任意机器学习模型结合使用，并且……
tldr: 该论文提出一个少假设框架及新颖的模型无关元学习器SurvB-learner，通过部分识别推导条件平均处理效应的边界，从而在信息性删失偏差下评估生存分析中异质性治疗效应估计的稳健性，并识别治疗有效的患者亚群。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an assumption-lean framework and a novel model-agnostic meta-learner (SurvB-learner) that uses partial identification to derive informative bounds on CATE, enabling robustness assessment of heterogeneous treatment effect estimates under informative censoring in survival analysis and identification of patient subgroups where treatment remains effective.
